items.title: security: remaining ways a folder becomes unknown to the git-config/output-file checks (follow-up to #1283)
items.body:
Follow-up to #1283, which the merge of #1294 at `0e2c02529d` closed. These same-class gaps came out of the #1294 reviews (rounds 5–7). Each one is a way a folder or value becomes unknown to the classifier, and main is quiet on all of them too. They are listed in https://github.com/CorbanuCore/CorbanuTerminal/issues/1283#issuecomment-6333481532 and in the round-6 notes on #1283:

- Variables neither reading knows: an unset or environment variable (`cd "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME"`), `printf -v D %s ~; cd "$D"`, `read D <<< ~`, `for D in ~; do cd "$D"; …; done`.
- `CDPATH=~ cd .` followed by relative writes.
- Order of execution: a function defined before `cd "$D"` and called after it; a loop whose `cd` comes after its `git config`.
- Positional parameters: `sh -c 'cd "$1"; git config -f .zshenv --comment x,--get a.b v' _ ~`.
- An attached wrapper folder value: `env -C"$D" sh -c '…'`.
- Wrapper folder flags not in `FOLDER_FLAGS`: `sudo -D`, `nsenter --wd=`, `docker exec -w`, `systemd-run --working-directory`.
- `cd` inside `source`d files, or in functions or aliases that wrap `cd`.

A broader fix would be one notion of "unknown folder" shared by both readings: any `cd` whose target either reading cannot resolve, plus wrapper folder flags in every spelling, makes relative writes ask.

items.title: Claude panes: deny user namespaces in contained panes under Moderate and Aggressive too (#826 follow-up)
items.body:
Follow-up of #826 / PR #876 (found by its review, round 1, minor).

**What:** under Moderate and Aggressive, Linux agent commands now can't create user namespaces (#876), so `unshare -Ur …` can't defeat nested-launch detection. Contained Claude panes (`contained_external_agents` + `secretless_agent_launch`) don't get that rule: `tui/src/claude_panes/containment.rs::level_rules` adds only the #758 keychain rule. A Bash command Claude Code runs in a contained pane could still `unshare -Ur corbanu exec …`. Documented as not covered in `docs/security-moderate.md` and `docs/security-aggressive.md`.

**Why it was left out:** Claude Code's own Bash sandbox (sandbox-runtime, bubblewrap on Linux) needs user namespaces; with the rule, a pane where the person turned that sandbox on would fail its commands. That changes what Claude panes can do, so it needs the owner's decision. The pane still runs inside Corbanu's sandbox either way.

**Options:**
- (a) Add the `:user_namespaces` entry to contained panes on Linux under Moderate and Aggressive (one line in `level_rules`, plus a test). Claude Code's own sandbox can't run in a pane then; Corbanu's sandbox still applies.
- (b) Leave panes out and keep the documented limit.

Recommendation: (a): the pane is already sandboxed by Corbanu, and nested-launch detection is the point of #826.
